info.title: Employee Onboarding Orchestrator API
info.description:
REST API for an AI-assisted new-hire onboarding orchestrator.

## The one idea

The model **proposes**, deterministic code **disposes**, and a human **authorises**.
An LLM proposal is never the system output. It must survive a numbered validator
chain (V1-V8) it cannot influence, against a policy corpus it cannot write to,
before a named person accepts responsibility for it.

## Authentication

Bearer JWT. `POST /api/v1/auth/login` returns a 15-minute access token and a
rotating refresh token. The access token carries identity and roles only —
**permissions and scopes are resolved server-side on every request**, so a revoked
grant takes effect immediately instead of at token expiry.

## Authorization

Every permission is `resource.action` held at a scope:

There are exactly three roles, matching the system architecture diagram:

| Role | Scope | What they may touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hr_admin` | `ORG` | Everything. The only role that can approve a plan. |
| `manager` | `REPORTS` | Their own direct reports only. No payroll access at all. |
| `employee` | `SELF` | Their own record only. |

Scope is checked against the TARGET ROW in the database, never asserted by the
token. A manager holding `plan.read` at `REPORTS` genuinely cannot read another
team plan, and the request returns 404 rather than 403 so the existence of the
row is not leaked.

## Errors

Every non-2xx response is an `ErrorResponse` with a machine-readable `error.code`,
a human `error.message`, an `error.requestId` to quote in bug reports, and — for
validation failures — `error.fields` listing each offending path.

## Conventions

- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; timestamps are RFC 3339 with offset.
- Lists are `{ items, meta }` with `page` and `pageSize` query parameters.
- Long operations return `202` with a job id; poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`.
- Out-of-scope rows return `404`, not `403`, so existence is not leaked.

> **Demonstration system.** The policy corpus is author-written for this challenge
> and is not legal guidance. Bank numbers and national ids are never stored.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login. Expires in 15 minutes; use /auth/refresh to rotate. The token carries identity and roles only — permissions and scopes are resolved server-side on every request.

notes.description: Free text from HR. Treated as UNTRUSTED data: it reaches the prompt inside a delimited block and is never followed as instruction.

isMock.description: True for every corpus document in this challenge. Surfaced in the UI so no one mistakes it for legal guidance.

quoteMatch.description: Similarity of the quoted span to the real clause body. Below threshold, V2 rejects the task.

dueDate.description: Always computed by the deterministic deadline engine (V6) from the jurisdiction business-day calendar. Never taken from the model.

authorityClass.description: PAY_AFFECTING and LEGAL tasks cannot be dispatched without a named human approval (V7).

origin.description: Where this task came from. VALIDATOR_INSERTED means the model omitted a mandatory task and V4 added it.

riskReason.example: Laptop lead time is 5 business days but start date is in 3.

refusalReason.description: Set when the system REFUSED to generate. Refusal is intended behaviour, not an error: an ungrounded plan is worse than none.
refusalReason.example: No approved policy source covers CONTRACTOR onboarding in IN-KA.

degradedReason.example: LLM unreachable. Baseline statutory plan generated from task templates.

slackDays.description: Business days of float. Negative means already late.

code.description: Machine-readable. One of CLAUSE_NOT_FOUND, QUOTE_MISMATCH, JURISDICTION_MISMATCH, MANDATORY_TASK_MISSING, UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY, CYCLE_DETECTED, DEADLINE_DIVERGED, AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, TASK_TYPE_NOT_IN_VOCABULARY, SCHEMA_INVALID.

acknowledgement.description: The approver confirms they have reviewed the AI-proposed tasks and accepts responsibility for them.

contentBase64.description: Base64 file content; maximum decoded size 5 MB.

leadTimeDays.description: Drives the at-risk calculation: order date = start date - leadTimeDays.

bankAccountNumber.description: Write-only. Never returned. Only last4 is stored.

nationalId.description: Write-only. Never returned. Only last4 is stored.

acknowledgement.description: Payroll verification is PAY_AFFECTING. The verifier is recorded in the audit trail.

jurisdictionCode.description: Null means the document applies globally.

isMock.description: True only for demonstration content; production policy sources are explicitly entered and approved by the organization.
